description: Wait until a condition holds: element visible, page text present, URL match, network idle, or a JS expression true. Prefer condition 'text' over a JS expression for 'has the page said X yet'. assert: true checks once and fails instead of waiting.

assert.description: Check once, fail if it does not hold; timeout 0, _meta.code 'assertion_failed'

expression.description: Expression that should become true; required for condition 'js'

selector.description: CSS selector or ref; required for condition 'element'

text.description: Substring of document.body.innerText, case-sensitive; required for condition 'text'

timeout.description: Max wait in ms (default 10000; 0 when assert is true)

url.description: Substring of the page URL; required for condition 'url'

name: wait_for
